claims.proof: Under the separately qualified fixed nonstale MTP2 public contract, a delivery retaining c outputs owns c consecutive necessary target input positions. The canonical necessary graph operates on these useful rows, excluding rejected/padded rows. A canonical exact dense leaf is freshly calibrated at this useful M; physical padded kernel latency is never extrapolated downward.

Choose the public-step cutoff at the latest first token over all200 requests. Every later retained delivery is decode-only. Retain every later positive delivery. No prompt partition, measured elapsed time, route distribution or efficiency is used to select waves.

For each of the first39 target decoders, TP2 splits GDN qkvz into local6144x2048 and BA32x2048, then the output is2048x2048; full attention qkv including Q gate is4608x2048 and output2048x2048. No bias or quantization; dense reference is BF16 linear with original sampler numerical controls.

DP1 and disabled expert parallel exclude sequence-parallel MoE and attention reduce-scatter. Both ranks therefore retain the complete useful-row M. The pure-decode bound M<=3*execution_seats<=108 lies outside Microflow partition sizes1024/2048/4096/8192; the canonical dense leaves are unsplit at this domain.

The canonical source order submits GDN qkvz then BA then out, or full-attention qkv then out, for each layer and ordered wave. Preserve this rank-local Cube resource order. Attention RowParallel output reduces both TP contributions before the following layer input. Replace deleted collective/MoE paths only by their transitive dependency joins, with no attributed arithmetic or measured-zero collective duration.

Delete all earlier waves, the entire final decoder/vocabulary, the MTP graph and all other unqualified families. All original leaf costs are nonnegative. Splicing dependencies after whole-leaf deletion yields a lower bound on the full independently calibrated canonical graph. Each retained dense leaf has its own exact shape/rank calibration; no partially measured GMM or monotonic shape assumption is used.

This certifies the retained graph domain and its deletion argument, not a complete whole-chain time. Necessary F, native T, independent calibration/audit and their own workload/source bindings must also pass before computing an efficiency lower bound.
